Daphnetin-8-glucoside is directly linked to Endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 2, which in turn is a target of Tinophylloloside. Tinophylloloside is then implicated in targeting Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit. This chain of interactions implies that Daphnetin-8-glucoside may act through Tinophylloloside to influence the structural subunit of Dr hemagglutinin. The mechanism is likely mediated by the enzyme Endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 2, which could modulate the activity or stability of Dr hemagglutinin. The evidence suggests a possible functional relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
